description: This file defines the 'ViewNoteScreen' component for a React Native mobile application, responsible for displaying a note, including functionalities for copying and sharing the note content. It manages state, performs side effects (fetching note data), and includes styling and navigation logic.

methods.name: ViewNoteScreen
methods.description: Main functional component displaying a note with options to edit, copy, and share.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies the note's title and content to the clipboard.

methods.name: share
methods.description: Shares the note's title and content via React Native's Share API.
